crossRefs.note: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made…
Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

people.name: Malchijah
people.line: Goldsmith who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

people.name: Muster_Gate
people.line: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned in Nehemiah's time

translations.web: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.
translations.bsb: Next to him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the upper room above the corner.
translations.kjv: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
translations.asv: After him repaired Malchijah one of the goldsmiths unto the house of the Nethinim, and of the merchants, over against the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.
